extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Plant modifications — plants modify their parts for special functions. Modified stems: potato, ginger (store food underground). Modified roots: carrot, radish, sweet potato (store food). Modified leaves: cactus spines (reduce water loss), pitcher plant (trap insects). (2) Animal habitats and feeding habits — Herbivores eat only plants (cow, deer, elephant). Carnivores eat only meat (tiger, lion, eagle). Omnivores eat both plants and animals (human, bear, crow). Habitat is the natural home where an animal lives (forest, pond, desert, ocean). (3) Crop types — Kharif crops: sown at the start of monsoon (June-July), harvested in autumn (October-November). Examples: rice, maize, cotton, soybean, pulses. Rabi crops: sown in winter (November-December), harvested in spring (March-April). Examples: wheat, gram, mustard, peas, barley. Basic cultivation practices: ploughing, sowing, irrigation, weeding, harvesting. (4) Food adulteration — adding cheap or harmful substances to food to make more profit. Common adulterants: milk adulterated with water, turmeric with metanil yellow (a poisonous dye), honey with sugar syrup, mustard oil with argemone oil, tea leaves with colored sawdust, dal with kesari dal or stones. Harmful effects: food poisoning, stomach problems, long-term diseases. Detection: unusual color, smell, taste, or texture. (5) Personal hygiene — diseases from unclean surroundings: diarrhea, cholera, typhoid, dysentery (from contaminated water and food), skin infections (from dirt and sweat), respiratory infections (from dust and pollution). Hygiene practices: wash hands before eating and after using toilet, bathe daily, brush teeth twice daily, keep nails clean, drink clean/boiled water, keep food covered, keep surroundings clean. Misconceptions: 'potato is a root' (WRONG — potato is a modified underground STEM, not a root; it has 'eyes' which are buds), 'kharif and rabi are the same' (WRONG — kharif crops are sown in monsoon and harvested in autumn; rabi crops are sown in winter and harvested in spring), 'food adulteration only affects taste' (WRONG — adulterants like metanil yellow and argemone oil can cause serious diseases like cancer and epidemic dropsy), 'washing hands is only needed after using the toilet' (WRONG — hands should be washed before eating, after playing, after handling animals, and after coughing/sneezing), 'all diseases come from germs in air' (WRONG — many diseases like diarrhea and cholera come from contaminated water and food, not just air).
